name: list_clusters
description: Lists all clusters for Google Cloud Managed service for Apache Kafka in a given project and location.

filter.description: Optional. Filter expression for the result.

orderBy.description: Optional. Order by fields for the result.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of clusters to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListClusters` call.

parent.description: Required. The parent location whose clusters are to be listed. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}
